description.value: Sun Country Cycle is a full-service bicycle shop in Vernon, BC, carrying Trek, Norco, and Yuba brands across a broad range of disciplines including mountain, road, urban, and electric bikes. The shop has a dedicated service and repair department and carries an extensive inventory of parts and accessories, making it a well-equipped stop for touring cyclists in the Okanagan. They also sell and service e-bikes, with electric-specific categories prominently featured across the site.
